description: Image Description: The image depicts a bathroom interior with a focus on a corner of the room. At the bottom of the image, there is a white, round bathtub integrated into the tiled corner. The bathtub is surrounded by beige tiles that extend up the wall. Above the bathtub is a tall, rectangular window with a white frame. The window features closed blinds, and through the blinds, an outdoor scene is partially visible, suggesting the presence of a tree and possibly a waterfront or ocean view in the distance
